annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部办公厅 民政部办公厅关于开展智能养老服务机器人结对攻关与场景应用试点工作的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Offices of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Civil Affairs on Launching the Pilot Program for Paired Research and Scenario Application of Intelligent Elderly-Care Service Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部办公厅; 民政部办公厅 (MIIT General Office; Ministry of Civil Affairs General Office)
named_instruments_referenced: 十四五机器人产业发展规划
annotation.summary_en: Chinese MIIT and Ministry of Civil Affairs notice launching a 2025–2027 pilot pairing robot developers with elderly-care users to refine and validate intelligent elderly-care service robots in homes, communities and institutions, with safety, certification, standards development and incident-reporting requirements for participants.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot period 2025–2027 pairing robot makers with elder-care users across home, community and institutional settings
Minimum validation: 200 households/units for home robots; 20 communities or institutions for community/institutional robots; at least 6 months
Applicants must address functional failure, electrical, mechanical, HRI, battery and data privacy risks and obtain mandatory testing certification
Required safety staff, training, incident reporting and bimonthly reports; pilot eligibility terminated for serious unresolved hazards or accidents
Encourages developing product, service and evaluation standards on safety, reliability and age-friendliness
